newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Gunfire at OAU headquarters in Ethiopia.
newsitem.headline: Gunfire at OAU headquarters in Ethiopia.

text.p: Prison guards pursuing escaped prisoners fired inside the headquarters compound of the Organisation of African Unity (OAU) in Addis Ababa on Monday, diplomats said.
They said some prisoners who escaped from the nearby main prison jumped over the fence of the OAU headquarters and entered the compound. Guards in hot pursuit opened fire, the sources said.
They said some escapees were captured and one might have been wounded. Police said a statement would be issued later.
